FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 387
Committee: Ports, Waterways and Intermodal Transit Sponsor: Representative Shane Stringer
Analyst: Mathieu Fuller Date: 02/17/2026
House Bill 387 as introduced could increase the administrative obligations of certain water and
sewer boards to hold public hearings relating to the closure or restriction of recreational use of
public water bodies. This bill could also increase the administrative obligations of local circuit
courts to hear appeals against restrictions and closures of public water bodies.
